decisions.reason: It stayed on its own webpage through 2024, so it likely meets a minimum aspiration level after a weaker comparable carpet was already pruned, making retention more likely than withdrawal.
Its continued standalone presentation suggests this differentiated premium carpet is performing acceptably enough relative to aspirations to justify keeping it despite being a niche line.
The move from a dedicated page in 2023 to only a brief mention in 2024 indicates results below aspiration and a likely search to reallocate resources away from this product.

Because it still had its own page in 2024, management would probably view it as sufficiently viable to continue, though the earlier disappearance of another similar carpet keeps the exit risk material.
A standalone page in both years for a product close to the firm’s core furniture business suggests acceptable performance and enough confidence to keep it on the market.
